prompt_meta.title: E2E Stabilization + Android/iOS Simulators + Real Mobile E2E Runs + RC Checklist PASS + GitHub push

owner_actions.when: only if macOS prompts require OS password/TouchID or Apple Developer license acceptance UI to proceed
owner_actions.instruction: Approve system prompt (password/TouchID/license accept) only. No command execution.

step_objectives.goal: Convert STEP-0015 into truly passing end-to-end validation by stabilizing Web E2E, provisioning Android/iOS simulators, running real Mobile E2E, and producing a PASS RC checklist with evidence.
outcomes: Web E2E passes locally and in CI (no timeouts)
Android emulator runs the app; iOS simulator runs the app (or BLOCKED with exact reason)
Mobile E2E runs on Android emulator and passes (not stubs)
Visual evidence captured for Web + Android + iOS (screenshots + logs)
Changes committed and pushed to GitHub main; CI green
constraints: No new features; only test stabilization, tooling, bug fixes needed to pass E2E and simulator runs.
Push provider may be mock/logging; validate via send-attempt logs + navigation actions.
definition_of_done: apps/web e2e passes using a deterministic server strategy (prefer next build + next start for CI)
Android emulator is installed/booted and app is launched successfully with evidence
iOS Simulator is booted and app is launched successfully with evidence (if feasible on this machine)
Mobile E2E passes on Android emulator (Maestro or IDE-chosen replacement) with evidence
ops/RELEASE_CANDIDATE_CHECKLIST.md shows all critical journeys PASS
Root gates pass: integrity, lint, test, build + e2e

critical_journeys_must_pass: Auth: signup -> login -> logout -> session persists -> protected screens gated
Approval joins: request -> approve/deny -> notifications reflect state
Private invites: token -> redeem -> join works
Venues: list/detail -> create game with venue -> game shows venue
Clubs: create (web) -> join request -> approve -> club-hosted game rule enforced
Chat: send/receive via polling -> block hides messages -> report persists
Ratings: eligible rating -> aggregation shows badges
Push: if mock/logging, verify send-attempt logs for chat + game approval and payload routes match docs

tasks.name: Stabilize Web E2E (no CI timeouts)
tasks.objective: Fix Playwright timeouts by using a deterministic webServer strategy and increased readiness checks. Prefer prod-like 'build + start' in CI.
acceptance: CI job runs e2e reliably (documented in report)

tasks.name: Provision and boot Android emulator
tasks.objective: Install/validate Android SDK/emulator tooling, create/boot an AVD, run the app on emulator, and capture screenshots.
constraints: Owner runs nothing; only credential prompt approval allowed
acceptance: Android emulator running + app launched + evidence captured

tasks.name: Provision and boot iOS Simulator (macOS)
tasks.objective: Validate Xcode + sim tools, boot iOS Simulator, run app, capture screenshots.
constraints: If blocked by missing Xcode/licensing, mark BLOCKED with exact evidence; do not ask owner to run commands
acceptance: iOS sim running + app launched + evidence captured OR BLOCKED with precise reason

tasks.name: Run real Mobile E2E on Android emulator
tasks.objective: Make Maestro (or alternative chosen by IDE) run against a running app on Android emulator and pass for auth + one core flow.

tasks.name: Update QA playbook + RC checklist to PASS
tasks.objective: Update ops/QA_PLAYBOOK.md and ops/RELEASE_CANDIDATE_CHECKLIST.md so that all required journeys are marked PASS with notes/evidence links.

tasks.name: Quality gates + GitHub push
tasks.objective: Run all gates + e2e, fix any failures, then commit and push to main.
acceptance: Commit hash + push evidence in report

rules: Store screenshots and small logs here
Do not commit huge videos; if needed, keep short and compressed or reference from report without committing

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Do not delegate execution to the owner. Stabilize web e2e, provision and run Android emulator and iOS simulator if feasible, run real mobile e2e on Android (not stubs), capture evidence, make RC checklist all_passed=true, keep CI green, commit and push to GitHub main, update ops/manifest.json, and write a complete reports/STEP-0016.report.json with no placeholders.
